title: Information we do not have — each gap names the route that would close it and who can close it
rule: a gap is 'official-blocked' when no league page read in this repository carries the item, and 'owner-blocked' when the answer is a decision rather than a fact. Suggestions are made here to discover missing information; none of the routes below is implemented by this namespace.

rows.item: Opening and closing prices for every market we originate
rows.why_needed: without it there is no residual, no CLV, no vig decomposition, no ROI, and no reward payout
rows.official_source: none found: nfl.com/odds/ and nfl.com/betting/ both serve the league 404 page (read 2026-11-16)
rows.route: owner picks CD-02 A (licence), B (decline) or C (labelled archive); if C, store the archive with its own hash and never title it 'market'
rows.cost: licence: money; C: one storage decision

rows.why_needed: the '2nd/3rd/4th string' deficiency model needs an official ranking, and 1 of 32 club paths probed so far 404s
rows.route: scripted sweep of all 32 club paths, recording HTTP status and the printed 'as of' date per club; publish the table even when it says 32 × absent

rows.item: An official per-player snap count source
rows.why_needed: 'model depth from playing time, not jersey order' is unimplementable without it
rows.official_source: not found in the four chunks of the official Game Summary read; defensive tables carry TKL/AST/SK/TFL/QH/IN/PD but no snaps
rows.route: read all chunks of ≥3 game books from raw bytes; probe Next Gen Stats player tables; if both fail, publish that the playing-time route is officially closed and switch the model to starter/no-starter facts

rows.item: Raw response bytes with a server-side timestamp for every capture
rows.why_needed: every 'clock time' in this repository is a client-side approximation, and an empty cell cannot be distinguished from a rendering loss
rows.official_source: not available through the read path used by agent sessions (no headers returned)
rows.route: CD-04 option A + CD-05: the collector stores payload + sha256 + its own UTC stamp and, where a server Date header exists, that too
rows.unblocks: point-in-time ledger, drift alarms, delta-not-level claims

sources.label: this namespace's read log and its stated limitation

rows.item: Terms on which the game-book-derived tables may be published
rows.why_needed: the document restricts itself to media coverage; two peer namespaces already publish transcribed tables
rows.route: write the permission posture into the publication contract (CD-03 A), or ask the league (B)

rows.item: Game-book coverage for past seasons (the backfill question)
rows.why_needed: a multi-season corpus is the only way to give a one-bet-per-fixture strategy 300 graded games under the peer floor, and the label source is the game book
rows.official_source: untested — a guessed 2025 slug 404s, which proves nothing either way
rows.route: take 5 real 2025 fixture slugs from the official 2025 schedule page, check each game centre for a game-book link, record static URL + fetch time

rows.item: Operator rules for void/push/rewrite of parlays and props
rows.why_needed: a combo cannot be settled without them, and the joint-evidence gate requires them in writing
rows.official_source: none — no league page states an operator's settlement rule
rows.route: name one operator whose terms the register will use, archive the terms text with a hash and a date, and re-archive on change

sources.label: peer register recording the same absence

rows.why_needed: 'publish the delta, never the level' and 'store every read with its clock time' both depend on knowing WHEN
rows.official_source: not exposed to an agent session
rows.route: same as G-04; until then, publish an ordering + window and say so

rows.item: The league's own injury-reporting policy document, dated
rows.why_needed: the capture schedule should not be guessed from third-party explainers that disagree
rows.official_source: not found on the paths read; searches this session returned only third-party accounts with conflicting deadlines
rows.route: ask for the policy PDF reference from the transactions/operations hub the peer registers cite, and store whatever the collector finds with a hash; otherwise define cadence empirically from captures

rows.why_needed: totals and passing models want it before the game, and the game book only tells us after
rows.official_source: game-book header only (post-game) for the fixture read
rows.route: probe each club's official stadium page for a roof field and check whether the game centre exposes it before kickoff on an upcoming fixture

rows.item: A multi-season archive of designations joined to inactives
rows.why_needed: the calibration of Out/Questionable/Doubtful needs thousands of rows, not one fixture
rows.official_source: game books + reports for past weeks, subject to G-06 and G-05
rows.route: if 2025 game books are reachable, build the join table once and publish play rate per designation with intervals and n
rows.cost: the largest single job on this board

sources.label: the join demonstrated on one fixture

rows.why_needed: the brief's whole workflow — review suggestions, choose a path, then implement — requires a place a verdict exists as a fact
rows.route: adopt decisions.json in this namespace (or in the canonical namespace CD-01 chooses): one row per suggestion id, verdict, decided_by, decided_utc, commit hash; the landing-page counter reads it
rows.cost: one file, one commit per decision

sources.label: this register, whose verdict column is empty by design

rows.item: An official name-to-jersey-number map per club per week
rows.why_needed: the availability report prints names without numbers and the game book prints '<initial>.<surname> <number>', so the two documents can only be joined on surname; on one club that makes 'A.Brown' (lineups) and 'B.Brown' (Not Active) the same key
rows.official_source: the per-club roster page carries numbers; it was not read this session and its historical availability is untested
rows.route: capture the club roster page with the same collector run as the report, keyed by club and date, and join on (number) rather than (surname); publish the join failure rate alongside every availability table
rows.cost: one extra page per club per capture
rows.unblocks: CD-07's join becomes keyed; the 'who replaced whom' claim stops being name-matched

sources.label: the report that prints no numbers
